purpose: Clean semantic HoSo rule catalog for LLM document-code classification. Use this first; open hoso-rules.json only for source trace or unresolved ambiguity.
selectionPolicy: Pick exactly one documentTypeCode when evidence clearly maps to one semantic rule.
Use requiredForCode to decide which business fields must be present before preview.
Do not invent master codes; values for DuAn, GoiThau, PhapNhan and NhaThau must come from user evidence or active SharePoint master data.
For parent-contract children IPC, VO, PL and FAC, prefer ParentContractCode when available; otherwise derive it only from DuAn, PhapNhan, NhaThau and ContractSequence.
When examples and prose conflict, include the ambiguity in evidence and ask one business question unless the ambiguity note resolves it.
